summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering subject triples, blank-node recursion guarded by the result's existing subject triples, and reification via rdf:subject without type or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (inline Turtle fixture in setUp, tearDown closes graph) covering counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion in reification, a blank-node cycle, and source immutability. No commits made. Tests were not run and flake8 was not run; expected counts are hand-derived and need a first run to confirm.
